findings.message: The generated non-wrapper probe looks up binary names containing literal quotation marks, causing verification to fail for correctly installed binaries. The unquoted heredoc emits `command -v \"jq\"` for the manifest's first entry, jq. The remote shell treats the escaped quotes as characters in the command name, so the lookup returns empty; lines 280–282 then report missing_binary:jq and exit. Both container and sandbox-image verification use this probe.
